caption:
Before you call a market bullish, check what its swing points are actually doing.

A sequence of higher highs and higher lows can describe upward structure. Lower highs and lower lows can describe downward structure. One swing alone does not define the whole market, and structure can change. Mark the swings, zoom out for context, and wait for confirmation instead of forcing a label.

Educational content only; not financial advice.
